punchline: A coach who had never played basketball made twelve-year-olds press the whole court, and they reached the nationals.
thirty_sec: Vivek Ranadivé coached his daughter's untalented Redwood City girls team without knowing basketball, so he had them run a full-court press in every game. It cost effort, not skill, and the team reached the national championship tournament.
question: Which polite, unspoken rule of your field are you following only because everyone else does?
key_contrast: Not more talent, but more effort where nobody expects it.
